data.title: ‘Youth Are The Architects Of Viksit Bharat 2047’
data.description: #WATCH | It is a matter of immense pride and great pleasure for me to be part of the 57th Convocation of IIT Delhi in the august presence of PM @narendramodi. After taking additional charge as the Minister of Education, this is my first public programme at an educational institution in the presence of the Prime Minister. I feel truly honoured and blessed to be here with you all. PM Modi has always reposed immense faith in the potential of India’s youth and regarded them as the foremost architects of Viksit Bharat 2047. Today, more than 4.5 crore students are enrolled in higher education. Since 2014, the number of universities has increased by nearly 70%. More than 650 new universities, 14,000 new colleges, over 4,000 new ITIs, nine new IIMs, seven new IITs and 13 new AIIMS have been established.
